I am running the `model_fields.test_jsonfield` test suite to verify the changes.
I have resolved the issue in [json.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py):

- Added [`HasKeyLookup.compile_json_path_final_key()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L175-L177) so that the final key in [`HasKeyLookup.as_sql()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L179-L207) (used by [`HasKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L236-L239), [`HasKeys`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L242-L248), and [`HasAnyKeys`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L251-L254) on SQLite, MySQL, and Oracle) is always compiled as a JSON object key rather than an array index when the key is numeric, while preserving array index compilation for any preceding [`KeyTransform`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L310-L364) path segments.
- Added [`HasKeyOrArrayIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L257-L259) for [`KeyTransformIsNull`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L393-L415) and [`KeyTransformExact`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tyf86zz3/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L446-L483) so that `isnull` and `exact=None` lookups on array index transforms continue to compile integer segments as array indices.
